title: Generalizable neural decoding for clinically scalable brain-computer interfaces
abstract: This paper explores generalizable neural decoding approaches to enable clinically scalable brain-computer interfaces.

title: A neural architecture for imagined and overt speech motor dynamics
abstract: Presents a neural architecture for decoding imagined and overt speech motor dynamics, with relevance for speech BCIs.

title: A Multitasking EEG Dataset for Cognitive Workload
abstract: Freely available dataset supporting cognitive workload classification, signal quality assessment, and adaptive BCI development.

title: Highly stretchable, hair-compatible multichannel neural interfaces for EEG monitoring and BCI applications
abstract: Introduces MindStretcH, a reusable platform for long-term EEG monitoring and BCI applications in laboratory, clinical, and home settings.

title: Biophysically constrained learning from healthy neural architectures improves brain-computer interface decoding
abstract: Provides proof of concept for improving decoding in compromised networks by harnessing healthy neural dynamics, laying foundation for neuroprostheses.

title: Brain-computer interfaces and the future of mental privacy
abstract: Discusses rapid advances in brain-computer interface technologies and implications for mental privacy.

title: Theta synchronization coordinates ventral temporal and frontal regions during visual working memory
abstract: Investigates theta synchronization in working memory, with relevance for cognitive BCIs.
